headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2021, the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Darby Allin vs. John Silver went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.35 ? a well-worked match. John Silver was challenging for gold for the very first time. This stood as the 20th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a notable milestone for the title. A tribute match, with Allin honoring the late Brodie Lee by opening his title to The Dark Order ? Silver even paid homage to his fallen leader by attempting his signature powerbomb, but Allin countered for the win, sharing a respectful fist bump with Silver afterward.
